routes.name: Visa-free entry for EU and Schengen nationals
routes.summary: EU and Schengen nationals enter with just a valid national ID card. The ministry also has a visa-free list for other nationalities on its Check if you need a visa page, which was not read.

other: Other nationalities: see mfa.gov.mk Check if you need a visa page

routes.name: Visa-free entry for EU/Schengen residents and Schengen, US, UK, Canada visa holders
routes.summary: Non-EU people with residence in an EU/Schengen state or a multiple-entry Schengen C visa can stay up to 15 days per entry (90 in 180). Holders of multiple-entry UK, US or Canadian visas get up to 15 days under a temporary decision for 2026.

other: Visa must be valid at least 5 days beyond planned stay
UK, US, Canada decision runs 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026

stay.note: 15 days per entry, 90 days in any 180 for residents and Schengen visa holders

routes.name: Type C Short-Stay and Transit Visa
routes.summary: Short stay visa for up to 90 days, or transit up to 5 days, for people who need a visa. Apply in person at a North Macedonia embassy or consulate.

other: Apply 15 days to 6 months before travel

routes.name: Type A Airport Transit Visa
routes.summary: Exists for airside transit. The ministry page does not say which nationalities need it. Check the ministry's visa check page.

routes.name: Type D Long-Stay Visa
routes.summary: Long-stay visa issued only after the Ministry of Interior grants temporary residence. Covers work, study, training, volunteering, research, medical care, family reunion and humanitarian reasons.

other: Temporary residence approval from Ministry of Interior first
Also open to close family of citizens, people of Macedonian origin, children born in the country
EU or OECD residents who buy property worth at least 40,000 EUR
Only valid for the stated purpose
